entry.title: PlateauXXL 0.4.1
entry.summary: **PlateauXXL — Valley Audio's Plateau reverb, patched with its own LFOs, random sources and sequencers, running natively inside MPC OS on the Akai Force.** Put it on a track, a submix or the master: huge Dattorro plate tails, Hold to freeze the tank, Clear to empty it, Tuned mode for pitched resonances, and every one of the module's 15 CV jacks patched to a modulation source running inside the plugin. Everything sits in one insert slot, with its own touchscreen pages and Q-Links, follows the MPC
